title: A Wolf for the Sigil
author: Lena Whitlock
blurb: Sable Villalobos, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
